title: Employee Scheduling Solution v3.0
description: The output half of a package: problem + optional solution -> algorithm -> package. Records which daily working assignment each worker took on each day [x_wdh = 1]. Two things this enables: warm-starting a run from an existing schedule, and pipelines where one phase's solution is the next phase's starting point. Assignment ids and employee ids refer to the expanded problem this solution belongs to. Standalone: this file does not reference any other schema. Symbols in square brackets refer to MathematicalDefinition7.

problemId.description: metadata.problemId of the problem this solves.

phaseIndex.description: Index into optimization.pipeline, when the problem used one.

status.description: A 'feasible' or 'timeout' solution may still be worth warm-starting from; 'infeasible' and 'error' carry no assignments.

objectiveValues.description: Reported objective components, for comparing phases and runs.

goal.description: e.g. 'minimize_shortages' (ObjectiveFunction1, sum of z_dts), 'skill_priority_weight' (ObjectiveFunction2 -- the total priority weight of the assigned team/level combinations, derived from demand.priorityOrder), 'preferable_days_off_worked' (ObjectiveFunction3, sum of x'_wd).

assignments.description: One entry per employee. Days on which the worker was assigned nothing may be listed with a null assignmentId or omitted entirely.

assignmentId.description: The chosen assignment [the h with x_wdh = 1], which must be one of this worker-day's assignmentIds in the expanded problem. null = not working.

workedPreferableDayOff.description: True when this day was the worker's preferable day-off [D_wk] and was scheduled anyway [x'_wd = 1]. Surfaced because it is what ObjectiveFunction3 penalises.

skillPerSlot.description: Optional detail: which skill the worker served in each covered timeslot [y_wdts]. Omit when only the daily assignment matters.

shortfalls.description: Where coverage fell below the desired minimum [z_dts > 0]. There is no hard coverage constraint -- alpha_dts is the number of workers DESIRED and is pursued only through ObjectiveFunction1 -- so a perfectly feasible solution can still report shortfalls. This is the KPI surface for that.

minutes.description: Minutes from the start of the scheduling day (00:00). Values at or past 1440 express times after midnight, so a night shift 22:00-06:30 is 1320-1830 with no ambiguity.
